title: Flightdeck vendor manifest
description: Drop a file like this into the vendors folder to add a launchable agent without rebuilding Flightdeck. Files whose names start with '_' are ignored.

$schema.description: Points at this schema so editors offer completion and validation.

id.description: Unique id. Must not collide with a built-in (claude, agy, pwsh, cmd, git-bash, wsl).

short.description: Compact name for chips and badges. Defaults to label.

kind.description: "agent" is an AI coding CLI; "shell" is a plain terminal (never needs sign-in).

accent.description: A theme token ("--aqua") or a literal hex colour ("#3FD79B").

exe.description: Executable to launch. Resolved through PATH unless it contains a path separator.

args.description: Arguments passed to exe on every launch.

env.description: Environment overrides. Keys set here are EXEMPT from Flightdeck's ambient API-key stripping — that is how a local endpoint gets its dummy key. Every other provider key is still stripped.

probe.description: What to check for install detection. A bare name goes through PATH; a value containing a slash is checked as a filesystem path. Defaults to exe.

authFile.description: Optional credential file whose presence means "signed in". "~" expands to the user profile. The file is never read or parsed — only its existence is checked. Omit if the agent needs no sign-in.

quietSeconds.description: Seconds of silence before a pane running this agent is treated as "waiting". Raise it for agents that think in long pauses; lower it for shells. Clamped to 1-60.
